title: Udon Whiteboard Script 1.0 (JSON form)
description: A list of commands for the Udon Whiteboard. Paste it into the board under "Befehle" → "Befehle ausführen".

cmd.description: Creates a rectangle. Default size 160 x 80.

id.description: Name for the new element, used by later commands (letters, digits, - and _). Optional.

x.description: Left edge in board coordinates (y grows downwards).

right.description: Place to the right of this element (instead of x/y).

left.description: Place to the left of this element.

text.description: Text inside the element. Use "\n" for a line break.

stroke.description: Line and text colour: a colour name or #rrggbb.

fill.description: Background colour: a colour name, #rrggbb or transparent.

left.description: Place to the left of this element.

text.description: Text inside the element. Use "\n" for a line break.

stroke.description: Line and text colour: a colour name or #rrggbb.

fill.description: Background colour: a colour name, #rrggbb or transparent.

fill.description: Background colour: a colour name, #rrggbb or transparent.

cmd.description: Creates free text without a frame.

id.description: Name for the new element, used by later commands (letters, digits, - and _). Optional.

x.description: Left edge in board coordinates (y grows downwards).

right.description: Place to the right of this element (instead of x/y).

left.description: Place to the left of this element.

cmd.description: Creates an arrow. With from/to it is attached to both elements and follows them when they are moved; otherwise give x1/y1/x2/y2.

id.description: Name for the new element, used by later commands (letters, digits, - and _). Optional.

stroke.description: Line and text colour: a colour name or #rrggbb.

cmd.description: Creates a line through points, or between two elements with from/to.

id.description: Name for the new element, used by later commands (letters, digits, - and _). Optional.

stroke.description: Line and text colour: a colour name or #rrggbb.

cmd.description: Creates a freehand stroke through the given points.

id.description: Name for the new element, used by later commands (letters, digits, - and _). Optional.

cmd.description: Creates a named frame (area). Elements listed in contains are put into the frame.

id.description: Name for the new element, used by later commands (letters, digits, - and _). Optional.

x.description: Left edge in board coordinates (y grows downwards).

right.description: Place to the right of this element (instead of x/y).

left.description: Place to the left of this element.

contains.description: Ids of elements inside the frame, separated by spaces, e.g. "a b c".

cmd.description: Moves elements by dx/dy, or one element to x/y (top-left corner). Attached arrows follow.

right.description: Place to the right of this element.

left.description: Place to the left of this element.

cmd.description: Changes the size of an element (top-left corner stays).
Rotates elements to the given angle (degrees, clockwise).
Changes colours and line style of elements.

stroke.description: Line and text colour: a colour name or #rrggbb.

fill.description: Background colour: a colour name, #rrggbb or transparent.

cmd.description: Replaces the text of an element (shape, note, text or arrow label).

text.description: New text. Use "\n" for a line break.

cmd.description: Changes font, size or alignment of the text of elements.
Turns elements into another kind of shape; position, size, text, colours and attached arrows stay. Shapes (rect, ellipse, diamond, note) change among each other, arrows and lines among each other.
Deletes elements (and their text). Arrows attached to them stay but are detached.
Adds a web link to an element (empty url removes it).
Locks elements so that they cannot be moved or changed by mistake.
Unlocks elements.
Groups elements so that they are selected and moved together.

id.description: Name of the group; can be used like an element id afterwards.

cmd.description: Removes the outermost group of the elements (or of the named group).
Brings elements to the front.
Sends elements to the back.
Aligns elements to each other.

edge.description: Edge or centre line to align on.

cmd.description: Distributes elements evenly between the first and the last one.
Selects elements on the board (only for you, not for the others).
Scrolls and zooms your view to elements, or to the whole board with "all" (only for you).
Undoes your last change on the board (a whole script counts as one change).
Redoes what undo has undone.
